_note: EP06 palette: northern New Mexico village at night, near-monochrome indigo + moon-silver, the ONLY warm accents are chile-red ristras and farolito candle amber. La Mala Hora: black rebozo, ash-grey split-tone skin, very long tangled black hair, hollow eyes with pinpoint silver glints, stylised teeth, no blood. Walker: muted denim hoodie (not white, sits behind captions). Distinct from EP05 (warm red rock) and EP04 (cold teal/moss).
_culture_markers: flat-roof adobe houses + small adobe church with bell
red chile ristras by blue/turquoise doors
farolitos (paper-bag candle lanterns) along adobe walls

mesa silhouette + yucca and cholla under the moon
